roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Acuity Scheduling, Payments

bullets: Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for payments, transactions, and mobile on Acuity
Lead rigorous problem discovery, deeply understanding customer, business, and market dynamics before pursuing major investments
Develop evidence-based problem statements grounded in user research, competitive analysis, and financial data
Define target segments, primary use cases, and expansion opportunities across web, mobile, and in-person payment contexts
Balance partner, build, buy, and deprecate decisions to accelerate GPV growth and customer impact

roles.title: Senior Product Director, Client Engagement Group

bullets: Own the multi-year mobile strategy across the native app, mobile web, and adapted product experiences, aligning executive stakeholders on the north star, target customers, and…
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers across two geographies, building a high-performing mobile product function
Drive measurable business outcomes in seller activation, engagement, and revenue through mobile product decisions
Define mobile-native experiences that leverage mobile-specific capabilities including in-person payments, real-time notifications, camera, and on-the-go workflows
Ensure new product experiences across the company are adapted for mobile with quality and consistency
